            "lineNumber": 403,

        ],
        "originalContents": "\n\n// =============================================================================\n// MAIN EXPORT PATHS TYPE MAPPING\n// =============================================================================\n\n/**\n * Type mapping for all possible import paths from @db package\n */\nexport interface DbPackageExports {\n  // Root exports (from @db)\n  '@db': {\n    PROVIDERS: ProvidersType;\n    ProviderRegistry: ProviderRegistry;\n    ProviderKey: ProviderKey;\n  };\n  \n  // Registry exports (from @db/registry)\n  '@db/registry': {\n    PROVIDERS: ProvidersType;\n    ProviderRegistry: ProviderRegistry;\n    ProviderKey: ProviderKey;\n  };\n  \n  // Xata exports (from @db/xata)\n  '@db/xata': {\n    // All generated types and client\n    XataClient: typeof XataClient;\n    getXataClient: () =\u003e XataClientInstance;\n    xata: XataClientInstance;\n    tables: typeof import('../xata/xata').tables;\n    \n    // All record types\n    TopicsRecord: TopicsRecord;\n    PersonnelRecord: PersonnelRecord;\n    EventsRecord: EventsRecord;\n    // ... all other record types\n    \n    // All model functions\n    // ... all CRUD functions from models\n    \n    // All API functions  \n    // ... all API functions\n  };\n  \n  // Client exports (from @db/xata/client)\n  '@db/xata/client': {\n    xata: XataClientInstance;\n  };\n  \n  // Models exports (from @db/xata/models)\n  '@db/xata/models': {\n    // All model CRUD functions and types\n    [key: string]: Function | Type;\n  };\n  \n  // API exports (from @db/xata/api)  \n  '@db/xata/api': {\n    // All API functions and types\n    askXataWithAi: Function;\n    askXata: Function;\n    searchXata: Function;\n    fetchRecords: Function;\n    xataToXYFlow: Function;\n    // ... all other API functions\n  };\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst DatabaseClient = buildClient();\n\nconst defaultOptions = {\n\tdatabaseURL:\n\t\t\"https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial\",\n\tapiKey: process.env.XATA_API_KEY,\n};\n\nexport class XataClient extends DatabaseClient\u003cDatabaseSchema\u003e {\n\tconstructor(options?: BaseClientOptions) {\n\t\tsuper({ ...defaultOptions, ...options }, tables);\n\t}\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import logging\nimport os\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Optional\n\n# Import the Xata client from the xata SDK.\n# Depending on your SDK version, you might do:\nfrom xata.client import XataClient\n\n# Initialize logging (optional)\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n# Setup: Retrieve Xata credentials from environment variables.\nXATA_API_KEY = os.environ.get(\"XATA_API_KEY\")\nXATA_DATABASE_URL = os.environ.get(\"XATA_DATABASE_URL\")\nXATA_BRANCH = os.environ.get(\"XATA_BRANCH\", \"main\")\n\nif not XATA_API_KEY or not XATA_DATABASE_URL:\n    logger.error(\n        \"Missing XATA_API_KEY or XATA_DATABASE_URL environment variable.\")\n    raise EnvironmentError(\"XATA API credentials must be set.\")\n\n# Extract database and branch info from URL\n# URL format: https://workspace-id.region.xata.sh/db/database_name\ntry:\n    from urllib.parse import urlparse\n    parsed_url = urlparse(XATA_DATABASE_URL)\n    path_parts = parsed_url.path.strip('/').split('/')\n    if len(path_parts) \u003e= 2 and path_parts[0] == 'db':\n        DATABASE_NAME = path_parts[1]\n    else:\n        DATABASE_NAME = \"ultraterrestrial\"  # fallback\n    DB_BRANCH_NAME = f\"{DATABASE_NAME}:{XATA_BRANCH}\"\nexcept Exception as e:\n    logger.warning(f\"Could not parse database URL: {e}\")\n    DATABASE_NAME = \"ultraterrestrial\"\n    DB_BRANCH_NAME = f\"{DATABASE_NAME}:{XATA_BRANCH}\"\n\n# Initialize the Xata client\ntry:\n    xata_client = XataClient(api_key=XATA_API_KEY)\n    logger.info(f\"Xata client initialized for database: {DB_BRANCH_NAME}\")\nexcept Exception as e:\n    logger.error(f\"Failed to initialize Xata client: {e}\")\n    raise EnvironmentError(\"Could not initialize Xata client\")",

        "originalContents": "import logging\nimport os\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Optional\n\n# Import the Xata client from the xata SDK.\n# Depending on your SDK version, you might do:\nfrom xata.client import XataClient\n\n# Initialize logging (optional)\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n# Setup: Retrieve Xata credentials from environment variables.\nXATA_API_KEY = os.environ.get(\"XATA_API_KEY\")\nXATA_DATABASE_URL = os.environ.get(\"XATA_DATABASE_URL\")\nXATA_BRANCH = os.environ.get(\"XATA_BRANCH\", \"main\")\n\nif not XATA_API_KEY or not XATA_DATABASE_URL:\n    logger.error(\n        \"Missing XATA_API_KEY or XATA_DATABASE_URL environment variable.\")\n    raise EnvironmentError(\"XATA API credentials must be set.\")\n\n# Extract database and branch info from URL\n# URL format: https://workspace-id.region.xata.sh/db/database_name\ntry:\n    from urllib.parse import urlparse\n    parsed_url = urlparse(XATA_DATABASE_URL)\n    path_parts = parsed_url.path.strip('/').split('/')\n    if len(path_parts) \u003e= 2 and path_parts[0] == 'db':\n        DATABASE_NAME = path_parts[1]\n    else:\n        DATABASE_NAME = \"ultraterrestrial\"  # fallback\n    DB_BRANCH_NAME = f\"{DATABASE_NAME}:{XATA_BRANCH}\"\nexcept Exception as e:\n    logger.warning(f\"Could not parse database URL: {e}\")\n    DATABASE_NAME = \"ultraterrestrial\"\n    DB_BRANCH_NAME = f\"{DATABASE_NAME}:{XATA_BRANCH}\"\n\n# Initialize the Xata client\ntry:\n    xata_client = XataClient(api_key=XATA_API_KEY)\n    logger.info(f\"Xata client initialized for database: {DB_BRANCH_NAME}\")\nexcept Exception as e:\n    logger.error(f\"Failed to initialize Xata client: {e}\")\n    raise EnvironmentError(\"Could not initialize Xata client\")",

        "contents": "# @db - Database Package\n**Last Updated**: July 30, 2025 15:45 EST  \n**Status**: ✅ **FULLY OPERATIONAL** - All import issues resolved\n\nDatabase abstraction layer for Ultraterrestrial Resurrection - UFO/UAP research platform with Xata integration, vector search, and comprehensive type safety.\n\n\u003e 🎉 **IMPORT RESOLUTION SUCCESS**: All import path errors have been resolved! The package is fully functional.  \n\u003e See [IMPORT_PATH_RESOLUTION_REPORT.md](./IMPORT_PATH_RESOLUTION_REPORT.md) for technical details.\n\n## Installation\n\nInstall dependencies:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nbun install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Import Guide\n\nThis package provides multiple import paths for different use cases:\n\n### Main Package (Registry \u0026 Types)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Import the provider registry and common types\nimport { PROVIDERS, xata } from \"@db\";\n\n// Use the Xata client\nconst topics = await PROVIDERS.xata.client.db.topics.getAll();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Registry Only\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Import just the provider registry\nimport { PROVIDERS } from \"@db/registry\";\n\n// Access Xata client\nconst client = PROVIDERS.xata.client;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Complete Xata SDK\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Import full Xata SDK (client, models, API functions)\nimport { xata, models, api } from \"@db/xata\";\n\n// Or import specific parts\nimport { xata } from \"@db/xata/client\";\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Types Only\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Import type definitions\nimport type { \n  TopicsRecord, \n  EventsRecord, \n  PersonnelRecord \n} from \"@db/types\";\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Available Scripts\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Development\nbun run dev              # Watch mode development\nbun run type-check       # TypeScript type checking\n\n# Database Operations  \nbun run test:db          # Test database connection\nbun run seed             # Run main seeding script\nbun run seed:simple      # Simple seed script\nbun run fix-and-seed     # Fix issues and seed data\nbun run analyze          # Database state analysis\nbun run query            # Quick database queries\n\n# Testing \u0026 Maintenance\nbun test                 # Run tests\n",

        "contents": "# Extracted Database Models\n\nThis directory contains Xata database models extracted from chat conversations. These files implement CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for the database tables in the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project.\n\n## Files Extracted\n\n1. &#96;personnel.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the personnel table\n2. &#96;organizations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the organizations table\n3. &#96;sightings.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the sightings table\n4. &#96;documents.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the documents table\n5. &#96;locations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the locations table\n6. &#96;artifacts.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the artifacts table\n7. &#96;mindmaps.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the mindmaps table\n8. &#96;summary-files.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the summary-files table\n9. &#96;users.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the users table\n10. &#96;user-saved-items.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for various user-saved-* tables\n\n## Important Note\n\nThese files have import paths that need to be adjusted for your actual project structure.
